currentParagraphText: “I just told you before. We do it for survival,” the Sovereign said. “If the grudge hampers survival, it goes against my Path far more. I already tried and failed to kill you. With that, I fulfilled my obligations and attempted to exact revenge. Moreover, the reason why my attempt failed lies with the Forest Fae, so if I bear any grudge now, it’s towards her.”
